title: Dino Polska: Serving Small-Town Poland - [Business Breakdowns, EP. 64]

reader_summary.headline: This is Matt Reustle and today we are breaking down Polish grocer, Dino Polska.
reader_summary.overview: This is Matt Reustle and today we are breaking down Polish grocer, Dino Polska. This wasn't a name on our radar at Colossus but the more we dug into the story, the more intrigued we became. It starts at the macro level in Poland.

key_points.text: It starts at the macro level in Poland.
And on a micro level, Dino operates a rigid playbook where they target small towns and replicate the same format store.
To break down Dino I am joined by Jon Cukierwar of Sohra Peak Capital Partners.
